al_rule: L = m/m10 + w mean(max(0, |z| - z_max)^2) + sum_i [mu_i/2 max(0, g_i + lambda_i/mu_i)^2 - lambda_i^2/(2 mu_i)], g_i <= 0 dimensionless relative to its limit; every multiplier_interval iterations, between Adam steps: lambda_i <- max(0, lambda_i + mu_i g_i); V_i = |max(g_i, -lambda_i/mu_i)|; mu_i <- min(penalty_growth mu_i, penalty_max) if V_i > penalty_progress x V_i at the previous update, only on the final beta level (continuation jumps would ratchet mu); Adam rate = learning_rate x rate_decay^level
